header: A named person as the first contact
lead: A picture, a name, a role, a sentence in their own words and two ways to reach them. The quote sits in a figure, so the name belongs to the words.
author: DI(FH) Kurt Dirnbauer
quote_text: You are welcome to send any complaints directly to us at office@webconsulting.at.
note: Show a current photo of the real person, or your logo. A stock portrait next to a direct line loses the trust this panel should build.
